However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.

3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory, Bhusawal . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory, Bhusawal A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. All other terms & conditions as per YIL procurement manual/procedure to be followed. 7. The Firm shall have requisite surface treatment facility like 7 tank phosphating, derusting etc. 8. Non-involvement in cartel formation : We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cartel with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIMIT ED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 10. Bidder Financial Standing : We hereby give an undertaking that “We are not under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceeding and not bankrupt”. 11. Inspection :Authorized representative of ED/OFBH on receipt of material at O.F. Bhusawal. 12. Safety Norms: The firm shall fulfil all safety norms of OFBH and shall provide all necessary PPEs as per

requirement of the job. During execution of work if Firm’s employees are not following safety norms or fou nd without required PPEs, then penalty of Rs. 1000/- per incident will be charge. Penalty amount will be de ducted by concern user section at the time of preparation of JCC 13. ATC Clause : I accept all Bid terms & conditions along with Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditio ns(ATC) and also, Buyer Added Text Based ATC clauses as per above referred GEM Bid. ANNEXURE “A” SCOPE OF WORK FOR SERVICES FOR POWDER COATING SERVICES WITH PLANT AND MACHINERY for Box H 2A (N118352318) 1) SCOPE:- This scope covers the Phosphating, Powder Coating, Gasket Fitting, Hot Water Testing, and Transit Packagi ng of Box H2A by the supplier at O. F. Bhusawal on whole job basis. The firm has to position skilled workm en, plant and machinery at OFBH. 2) Scope of the Firm:- (a) Scope covers following major activities:- 1. Shifting of Boxes & Lid (H2A) from Box H2A section to the PCP site of the firm in side OFBH. 2. Surface treatment i.e seven tank Phosphating process of 100 % boxes. 3. Powder Coating painting 4. Gasket fitting in Lid ( By Glue and press machine) 5. Hot water testing of Boxes 6. Rectification of boxes by gas welding/ suitable adhesive if required. 7. Packaging of Boxes in covering bags. 8. Maintenance of their Plant/machinery and cleaning of working area. 9. Assistance to Inspection team of OFBH/QC & QA 10. Any other activities deemed fit to meet the task. (b) Scope covers following provisioning to be done by the firm at OFBh:- 1. Manual Phosphating plant along with Pre & Post Surface Treatment tanks. 2. Oven and Powder Coating Booth. 3. Chemical for Phosphating (Class-2), De-greasing, De-rusting etc. 4. Adequate Skilled workers along with supervisor, who will monitor, maintain & liaison to get the work done. 3) Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall provide : 1. Site for plant and machinery. 2. Necessary finished/semi finished components. 3. Basic consumables like Powder paint, electricity, compressor, water, air, etc. 4. Trolley or Battery Car for material shifting 5. Gasket & Gasket Fitting machine 6. Glue for gasket fitment 7. Hot water testing facilities and equipment. 8. Gas welding equipment & consumable/ suitable adhesive 9. Covering bags for packaging of Box H2A lots 4) The firm must take utmost precautions in controlling the consumption of consumables items. Any consu mption exceeding the acceptable limit of estimate shall have to be borne by the firm. 5) Any Loss or damage to the Infrastructure/material shall have to be borne by the firm. 6) WORK SHIFT :- 1. The firm shall carry out subject job daily inside the factory from 07.30 AM up to 04.15 PM (with 45 Min utes lunch from 1230 Hours to 1315 Hours). 2. The shift time may vary round the clock as per the availability of the infrastructure. 3. The firm may be asked to work in more than one shift. 4. In case of exigency in work the firm may be asked for work on Sunday/Holiday. 7) DELIVERY:- The firm should have capacity to give minimum 600 QC passed boxes per shift. 8) QUALITY :- 1. The final job must comply to the quality requirements of Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. 2. Rectification: - Rectification, if any, shall have to be carried out by the firm. The rectification job shall n ot be counted separately. 9) SAFETY & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS :- 1. The firm shall fulfill all safety norms and shall provide necessary safety equipment i.e. gloves, shoes, welding goggles, mask, aprons, etc. as per the requirement of the job. 2. The firm shall fulfill all security requirements and shall not violate any rules and regulations of the fact ory. 3. The firm must arrange for Police verification of their worker and shall submit the PVR to Ordnance Fact ory Bhusawal.

4. The firm has to follow all labour laws and statutory rules applicable for above job i.e. Child Labour Act e tc 5. Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall not be responsible for any loss/damage to the firm and/or his men/m achines during the course of the work. 6. In case of any dispute, decision of the Executive Director O. F. Bhusawal will be final and binding. 10) MAINTENANCE OF RECORDS :- The firm shall maintain following records on daily basis, which must be counter signed by the OFBH/representative :- 1. Boxes, Components, raw material etc received from Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. 2. Record of temperature and Pointage of Phosphating bath on daily basis. 3. Down time of Phosphating Plant, Electricity, Air Compressors etc. 4. Numbers, Name and Signatures of the Workmen reporting. 5. Number of Boxes submitted for final passing. 6. Number of Boxes cleared in final passing. 7. Inspection report. 11) It is recommended that before quoting, the firm should visit Ordnance Factory Bhusawal to understand the job requirement and real assessment of work. 12) PENALTY:-It is the jurisdiction of OFBH to impose penalty - If the firm is not able to deliver the minimum quantity as mentioned in clause no. 7, they may be liable for penalty @ 1/4rd of supply Order Rate multipli ed by the total shortfall quantity. 13) The firm shall report at OFBH site for starting their job within 15 days from the date of placement of or der. 14) The firm shall arrange for their food and accommodation at their own cost at Bhusawal city. . 6.
